kb:7a3c2f1d.query: api gateway rest service integration sqs us-east-1
kb:7a3c2f1d.result_summary: API Gateway REST APIs support direct SQS service integrations via AWS service proxy without requiring a Lambda intermediary; recommended for low-latency, low-validation ingest paths.

kb:9b2e0c14.query: dynamodb conditional putitem idempotent writes streams new_image
kb:9b2e0c14.result_summary: DynamoDB conditional PutItem with attribute_not_exists provides exactly-once write semantics on a known primary key; Streams view type NEW_IMAGE emits the new item to consumers within milliseconds.

cw:e1ff8b22.query: lambda dynamodb apigateway recommended alarms us-east-1
